name: qa-damp-thermostat-barostat-001
description: In an NPT simulation using a Nose–Hoover thermostat and barostat, the damping parameters (Tdamp) and (Pdamp) define the characteristic relaxation times for temperature and pressure. Which relationship between them is generally recommended for stable coupling and to avoid unphysical oscillations?
